description: Transport: a master clock at 24 pulses to the quarter note, with run and reset outputs and a shared transport other TriggerFish modules follow

params.text: Plays on from the current position
Stops and returns to the beginning

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V, 24 times to the quarter note while the transport plays
10V while the transport plays, 0V while it is paused or stopped
A 1ms pulse at 10V when the transport returns to the beginning

notes: the tempo readout is clicked to open the tempo knob's own menu, where a figure can be typed in
the three lamps report whether the transport is playing, paused or stopped
a Prog Sequencer patched from the RUN output can drive this transport from its own keyboard shortcuts
